---
title: "Resources"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
resources <- read_csv("data/resources.csv")

# Generate Link to CSV files
for (i in 1: length(resources$link)) {
  if (endsWith(resources$link[i], ".csv")) {
    resources$link[i] <- sprintf(
      '<a href="resources/data/%s">%s</a>',
      resources$link[i],
      paste0("💾 ", resources$link[i])
    )
  }
}



# Generate Link to README for CSV files
for (i in 1: length(resources$notes)) {

  if (endsWith(resources$notes[i], "README.md") & !is.na(resources$notes[i])) {
    resources$notes[i] <- sprintf(
      '<a href="resources/data/%s">%s</a>',
      resources$notes[i],
      "🗒️ README"
    )
  }
}

# Generate General Links
for (i in 1: length(resources$link)) {
  if (startsWith(resources$link[i], "https://")) {
    resources$link[i] <- sprintf(
      '<a href="%s" target = "_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a>',
      resources$link[i],
      paste0("🌐 ", substr(resources$link[i], 1, 20), "..."
    ))
  }
}

# Select and rename columns
resources <- resources |> 
  rename(
    `Resource ID` = resource_ID,
    `Type` = type,
    `Title` = title,
    `Outcome ID` = outcome_IDs,
    `Link` = link,
    `Notes` = notes
    )


datatable(
    resources, 
    filter = "top", 
    options = list(pageLength = 10),
    escape = FALSE
    # class = "table table-sm"
)
```
